title: Boyfriend Beater Thinks She’s Above The Law
description:
This guy’s girlfriend punched him and ran off. The officer tried to look for the girl, but he didn’t realize that he was searching in the wrong bushes. All the while, the woman had been watching their interaction through the bushes, but the stalking wouldn’t continue for long. This is when one of the officers spotted the woman. Ah, one of those days when your victim card gets declined. Honestly, the officers deserve a raise for tolerating her. Her boyfriend, however, needs to change continents. Jesus better come fast, 'cause Satan's speaking through her. If you think she’ll calm down soon, you’ll be thinking again in sometime. All that begging wasn’t going to get her anywhere. Finally, they arrived at the hospital, where she’d be wreaking even more havoc. This woman knows everything—except when to stop whining. The woman was charged with domestic battery, battery upon a peace officer and resisting arrest.
